page.layout: One page of text, centred title block; below it a woodcut emblem (eagle with ribbon motto); imprint at the foot. No margin notes.
page.notes: The woodcut shows an eagle with a ribbon motto, the ribbon text is illegible at this scan resolution. A pen mark (R) in the left margin is handwriting and is not transcribed. The imprint date is printed CIↃ IↃ C LXI, i.e. MDCLXI.
